en.dr-ali-peiravi: 2-113 Al-Khalil ibn Ahmad al-Sejezy narrated that Muhammad ibn Mu’az quoted Al-Hussein ibn al-Hassan, on the authority of Abdullah ibn al-Mobarak, on the authority of Sho’abat ibn al-Haj’jaj, on the authority of Abi Qatadah, on the authority of Anas ibn Malik that God’s Prophet (MGB) said, “
The Children of Adam (people) will get old or die, but two things still remain young in them: greed and aspirations.”
